question: Can a private action-bound ordered-projector state token generate a causally valid next-round full-binary first record on two tiny exact D4 fixtures without leaking private support, and how does the no-new-fault repeat control constrain it?
role: Deterministic ideal no-new-physical-fault limiting matrix only, not a production five-round sampler or evidence of hidden-charge feedback
source_basis: Jing Appendix A.2/A.4 ideal charge projectors and red-X correction
J6L/J6M pinned periodic graph and vacuum orbit
J6O fixed two-edge full first/second law
J6Z complete six-edge-loop two-block public law and frozen caller gap

common.geometry_state: Pinned periodic L=2 graph and one J6M common vacuum orbit; physical red-X support private, ideal source projectors, no measurement noise
common.timing: Physical error; complete eligible first-star measurement; public red-X correction or defer; complete eligible action-conditioned second measurement when correction occurs; retain a private postselected projector-sequence state; zero new physical faults; measure complete eligible next-round first stars on the actual residual sector.
common.public_private: Return only 24-site flux/charge/vacuum arrays, action edge IDs and causal digests. Private physical support, operator masks, projector sequence, orbit and postselected-state token never enter decoder-visible dictionaries. A second record is absent on defer.
common.matched_keys: Use one fixed trial ID, geometry-specific physical and first-observation keys, and matched second-exogenous bit 0/1 for both two-edge action branches; keys serve deterministic counterfactual enumeration, not random sampling.
common.independent_unit: One fixed exact orbit per geometry with rational Born masses and counterfactual action branches; no Monte Carlo uncertainty

two_edge_path.next_first_rule: With no new fault or second action, next first measures all eligible stars on the residual sector. Compute an independent ordered first/second/next-first projector law on every positive prefix; defer omits the second block. Require exact normalization and compare to complete J6O public records.

six_edge_loop.next_first_rule: Use each complete J6Z first/second public prefix. With no new fault or further action, verify all eligible next-first projectors repeat the complete second record by projector idempotence and independently check at least one varying site by an ordered three-block moment.

acceptance: All six pins and frozen caller source hash pass before and after evaluation
Two-edge path positive cases and loop prefixes normalize exactly, have 24-site public arrays and reproduce pinned J6O/J6Z two-block laws
Ordered three-block no-new-fault next-first law passes repeat control at all variable sites; deterministic eligible sites stay +1
All seven anti-leak/action-binding controls reject, replay is exact and no private token is in public output
Zero stochastic histories, schedule arm evaluations, bootstrap replicates, new dependencies or frozen-caller changes; no noisy/JIT/threshold claim
stop_rule: Run path exact law first, then loop repeat fixture. Fail closed on pin, incidence, commutation, public/private, normalization, binding or replay drift; censor only an independent branch at the 60-CPU-second cap, never widen or change actions post hoc.
